facts: ground-truth elevation points are independently surveyed
survey points are collected on flat unambiguous surfaces
each ground-truth point has plus or minus 3cm RMSE accuracy
metadata records transformation and geoidal models used
ground-truth surveys may be reused only while sufficiently recent
general maximum reuse age is less than 5 years
coastal-project maximum reuse age is 3 years
timestamped LIDAR is compared against ground truth using RMSE standard deviation and random error
LIDAR surveys must report less than plus or minus 15cm RMSE and 10cm standard deviation/random error to pass QC

promotion_rule: Where timestamped LIDAR QC evidence is used, survey age, transform/geoid lineage and the EA RMSE thresholds must be preserved.
